name: Shisui, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Nara
positioning: Heritage hotel on the western edge of Nara Park, among World Heritage shrines and temples, with onsen rooms
best_for: Travelers who want to stay beside Nara Park and its World Heritage temples
Guests who want a room with a private natural hot spring bath

facts.text: The hotel sits on the western edge of Nara Park.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows looking onto greenery.
The accommodations are decorated with Nara's traditional artworks.
Rooms have natural light, an open space concept and lofty ceilings.
The room range includes a Presidential Suite with an onsen.
Restaurant Suiyou serves Japanese cuisine reflecting Nara's culinary culture, which the hotel says was shaped by the Silk Road.
The hotel was awarded one Michelin Key in 2026.
The fitness center is open 24 hours a day and is complimentary for staying guests.
Staff speak Japanese, English, Chinese and Korean.
Nearby train stations are Nara Station and Kintetsu Nara Station.

highlights.text: The Yoshikien area around the hotel is surrounded by World Heritage Sites such as Kasuga Taisha Shrine, Kofukuji Temple and Todaiji Temple.
Some rooms have their own private natural hot spring bath.
SUI Spa offers Nara massage and spa treatments using traditional Japanese and Chinese herbs nurtured by the nature of Nara.
Sushi & Bar Shousou is a modern counter-style sushi restaurant in the refurbished warehouse of the historic Governor's House, dating from 1922.
The name Shisui comes from the 'purple trunk and green leaves' (Shikan Suiyou), scenic vistas cherished in Nara since ancient times.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
Parking must be booked; the property is beyond the entrance gate and steps may prevent access for low vehicles.
WhataHotel notes limited nightlife in historic Nara.
